scientific_limitations: Only circumferences n=3^r with r>=1 and state-field characteristic three are addressed.
Exact counts are for labelled two-time-layer states, not rotational equivalence classes.
No claim is made for arbitrary corona graphs, nonlinear dynamics, or general circumferences.
An archival binary reversible-CA paper (Macfarlane 2004) was available only through its publisher abstract; the full manuscript was not obtained.
Unindexed equivalent results remain a priority risk; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: A fivefold ternary clock and exact orbit census on prime-power sunlets
